title: Distinct Clades of Protein Phosphatase 2A Regulatory B'/B56 Subunits Engage in Different Physiological Processes.
authors: Heidari, Behzad; Nemie-Feyissa, Dugassa; Lillo, Cathrine
one_liner_zh: 该文综述拟南芥PP2A调节亚基B'在信号传导和发育中的功能，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) is a strongly conserved and major protein phosphatase in all eukaryotes. The canonical PP2A complex consists of a catalytic (C), scaffolding (A), and regulatory (B) subunit. Plants have three groups of evolutionary distinct B subunits: B55, B' (B56), and B''. Here, the Arabidopsis B' group is reviewed and compared with other eukaryotes. Members of the B'alpha/B'beta clade are especially important for chromatid cohesion, and dephosphorylation of transcription factors that mediate brassinosteroid (BR) signaling in the nucleus. Other B' subunits interact with proteins at the cell membrane to dampen BR signaling or harness immune responses. The transition from vegetative to reproductive phase is influenced differentially by distinct B' subunits; B'alpha and B'beta being of little importance, whereas others (B'gamma, B'zeta, B'eta, B'theta, B'kappa) promote transition to flowering. Interestingly, the latter B' subunits have three motifs in a conserved manner, i.e., two docking sites for protein phosphatase 1 (PP1), and a POLO consensus phosphorylation site between these motifs. This supports the view that a conserved PP1-PP2A dephosphorelay is important in a variety of signaling contexts throughout eukaryotes. A profound understanding of these regulators may help in designing future crops and understand environmental issues.
abstract_zh: 蛋白磷酸酶2A（PP2A）是所有真核生物中高度保守且主要的蛋白磷酸酶。典型的PP2A复合物由催化（C）亚基、支架（A）亚基和调节（B）亚基组成。植物具有三组进化上不同的B亚基：B55、B'（B56）和B''。本文对拟南芥中的B'组进行了综述，并与其他真核生物进行了比较。B'alpha/B'beta分支的成员对于染色单体黏连以及介导油菜素内酯（BR）信号传导的转录因子去磷酸化尤为重要。其他B'亚基与细胞膜上的蛋白质相互作用，以减弱BR信号传导或调节免疫反应。从营养期向生殖期的转变受到不同B'亚基的差异性影响；B'alpha和B'beta作用较小，而其他亚基（B'gamma、B'zeta、B'eta、B'theta、B'kappa）则促进向开花的转变。有趣的是，后一类B'亚基以保守方式含有三个基序，即两个蛋白磷酸酶1（PP1）的对接位点，以及位于这些基序之间的一个POLO共识磷酸化位点。这支持了以下观点：保守的PP1-PP2A去磷酸化级联反应在真核生物的各种信号传导环境中具有重要意义。对这些调节因子的深入理解可能有助于设计未来作物并理解环境问题。
